Crane Collapse Traps Workers at Gujarat Construction Site

A section of an under-construction building collapsed at the 'Boski Empire' site in Kudasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, on Wednesday. At least 10 to 12 workers are feared trapped under the debris. Four to eleven workers have been rescued and admitted to Gandhinagar Civil Hospital. The incident occurred due to a crane collapse at the construction site.
